info.title: AWG-Forge node control API
info.description: Internal controller/node contract. Public CA bootstrap, enrollment claim/status, mTLS presence and certificate renewal are implemented on explicitly enabled listeners. Non-loopback exposure additionally requires exact endpoint consent and a verified retained encrypted backup. Snapshots are implemented; snapshot.refresh delivery is implemented; client.enabled.set delivery is implemented; other remote mutations remain proposed; this draft is not a public operator API.

post.description: Internal mTLS export channel, separate from durable operations. Current non-superseded certificate and exact pinned presence authority required. Dedicated result body is limited to 64 KiB; ready config to 16 KiB. Secrets are never stored in registry or receipts. Failed status requires empty config. Node rendering must recheck local state under the mutation/boot lock. No export retry after delivery.

200.description: Ephemeral typed delivery; wait_seconds must be zero.

put.description: Internal mTLS export channel, separate from durable operations. Current non-superseded certificate and exact pinned presence authority required. Dedicated result body is limited to 64 KiB; ready config to 16 KiB. Secrets are never stored in registry or receipts. Failed status requires empty config. Node rendering must recheck local state under the mutation/boot lock. No export retry after delivery.

204.description: Accepted once; no replayable secret result.

get.summary: Read public controller CA for pinned bootstrap
get.description: Secret-free and registry-free public CA discovery. Treat the response as untrusted: verify the exact existing CA SPKI sha256 pin, self-signed CA constraints and validity, then repeat over normally verified TLS1.3 chain/SAN/time before sending any enrollment secret. No proxy, redirect, query, Authorization or request body. Subject to existing bootstrap limits.

200.description: Public CA only; no invitation expiry, registry, credentials or management data.

post.description: The node verifies the controller CA/SPKI pin before sending this request. The invitation secret is supplied as a bearer value and must never appear in the URL, command arguments, environment, logs, or durable plaintext storage.

202.description: The CSR is bound to the invitation and awaits explicit controller approval.

get.description: An exact CSR retry returns the same claim capability until expiry; a competing CSR returns 409. The claim token is returned only by the successful claim response and is stored as a digest by the controller. An approved response contains the node certificate but never a private key. Public CA bootstrap, claim/status, presence and renewal are implemented on explicitly enabled endpoints; snapshot and snapshot.refresh routes are implemented; client.enabled.set delivery is implemented; other remote mutations remain draft.

put.description: Node identity comes from the verified client certificate. A node identifier supplied by a proxy header or request body is never authoritative. Invalid boot/state/binding authority returns 409 presence_fenced; temporary registry failure returns 503 control_unavailable and permits bounded retry.

200.description: Presence accepted and polling guidance returned.

put.description: The snapshot is an allowlisted observation from the authoritative node state. A newer desired_generation refreshes the controller's desired-state projection; a same-generation snapshot may refresh runtime observations when its snapshot_sequence is newer for the active boot_id. The controller never overwrites node state from its cache. The snapshot never contains private keys, preshared keys, full configs, QR or vpn:// payloads, WARP credentials, environment values, or raw command output. Implemented: validates current certificate, session, boot/state/binding fences and monotonic generation/sequence in one transaction. Collection budget 5 seconds, upload timeout 15 seconds, retry backoff with jitter capped at 30 seconds. Observations include runtime counters and a bounded runtime Doctor summary, not full local Doctor output.

200.description: Snapshot accepted; max body 512 KiB, 64 tunnels, 2048 total clients. One projection per identity, at most 1024 projections. Same generation must preserve exact desired metadata; a newer sequence refreshes observations only.

post.description: Implemented snapshot.refresh and capability-gated client.enabled.set. One active held poll per node, eight globally. Wait 0–5 seconds without app/DB locks, 40-second lease clipped to two-minute execution expiry until reconciliation. Current certificate/session/boot/epoch fencing on every dequeue. Duplicate delivery returns the same lease/evidence; superseded session or expired lease can reclaim read-only work. DB-off node may repeat collection after crash; no exactly-once execution claim. client.enabled.set requires its own capability. Delivered mutations remain reconciling after the execution deadline; reconciliation-only delivery cannot start a new mutation.

200.description: One operation is leased to the node.

204.description: No operation became available before the bounded wait elapsed.

put.description: Implemented allowlisted snapshot.refresh receipt. Current mTLS certificate/session/boot/epochs and unexpired exact lease required for initial completion. Succeeded result requires a snapshot accepted atomically with matching operation/lease correlation and sequence at the expected generation. Identical terminal replay under current authority is idempotent within retention (24 hours after operation expiry), even after lease expiry. Conflicting/foreign/late lease results are fenced. No secret artifacts or arbitrary diagnostics. Client mutations report their durable full-intent outcome under current node authority across old lease/boot/deadline; conflicting outcomes are rejected. Receipt reconciliation cannot alter node state.

204.description: Terminal result stored or an identical result replay acknowledged.

post.description: Requires the presented verified mTLS certificate and current registry binding. The body current_serial must match that peer certificate; boot_id is informational and does not establish identity. A signed extension-free Ed25519 CSR with a different key may renew at or after two thirds of the predecessor's actual validity interval. One predecessor gets one successor. An exact full-CSR retry from that predecessor returns the committed certificate only while the predecessor remains authorized; a different CSR conflicts. The predecessor overlap ends no later than 24 hours after commit or its own expiry, and revocation can end it earlier.

200.description: The committed replacement certificate, or the identical certificate from an authorized exact retry.

post.summary: Confirm node durable acknowledgement of a client result
post.description: Current node authority and exact immutable intent hash required. Node sends this only after durably recording the committed controller result. Confirmation permits bounded retention; unconfirmed results and delivered unresolved mutations are never time-evicted. Exact repeat is idempotent.

204.description: Terminal result stored or an identical result replay acknowledged.

nodeMTLS.description: AWG-Forge-managed node certificate verified by the dedicated control listener and checked against active node and binding state.

enrollmentSecret.description: High-entropy single-use enrollment secret entered interactively and accepted only with a verified controller CA/SPKI pin.

claimToken.description: Short-lived token returned after the controller atomically binds an invitation to one CSR. Only its digest is stored.

InvitationID.name: invitation_id
InvitationID.description: Non-secret identifier included in the controller-generated command.

RequestID.description: Safe correlation identifier for logs and audit events.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds before retrying a rate-limited request.

Problem.description: Safe RFC 9457 problem response without internal error details.

RateLimitedProblem.description: The request exceeded a bounded enrollment, node, or global limit.

BootID.description: Random identity generated on every application process start.

Epoch.description: Random identity epoch used to fence restored, reset, or cloned state.

csr_pem.description: PEM PKCS#10 CSR. The corresponding private key never leaves the node.

claim_token.description: Short-lived opaque token. The controller stores only a keyed digest.

boot_sequence.description: Persisted monotonic process-start sequence within one state_epoch. The controller accepts a replacement session only from a greater sequence; the same sequence may renew only the matching boot_id.

session_id.description: Controller-issued node session bound to the authenticated certificate, boot_id, boot_sequence, state_epoch, and binding_epoch.

current_serial.description: Must equal the serial of the verified mTLS peer leaf when a handler is implemented; it does not select the renewal identity.

csr_pem.description: PEM encoding of the signed CSR. Idempotency is based on the exact decoded full CSR DER, not the key or subject.

detail.description: Safe actionable detail without stack traces, commands, paths, or secret material.
